title: Kubernetes platforms
summary: Give engineering teams a Kubernetes platform they can operate, secure and evolve with confidence.
overview:
Your teams want Kubernetes to make application delivery easier. Without consistent security, observability and operating workflows, the platform can introduce another layer of uncertainty instead.

We design and build Kubernetes foundations that fit the environment you already run. Across upstream Kubernetes and enterprise distributions such as OpenShift, we bring delivery workflows, operations and developer enablement together so your teams can use and evolve the platform with confidence.
positioning: Build a Kubernetes platform your engineering teams can understand, operate and change safely.
outcomes: Deliver applications through a clearer path
Give developers a more consistent experience
